propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record that Jira Data Center landed as a second backend ahead of GitHub, falsifying three existing statements that claimed the first real second backend was out of scope

The jira_family sub-seam layer requires two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) and a shared provenance decision via RemoteRef.instance that remains unimplemented in production code despite being declared

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only if the port is complete and typed; TicketTransport declares six members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct members across attribute access, with twelve absent and unmapped to any Protocol
RemoteRef.instance is presented as intended design with a named gap rather than as existing reality, since grep -rn RemoteRef( src/ returns nothing and only test helpers construct it

User-guide documentation must state least-privilege expectations, ca_bundle for internal CAs, allow_insecure as cleartext-only, and resolved_statuses for non-standard workflows, verified against a real Data Center instance

The March 2029 read-only date for Data Center and the consequent time-boxed framing of this investment must be stated plainly in the ADR to inform future maintainer decisions on extension versus retirement
